name: prompt-601
image_vibe: Polished blonde studio glamour with warm caramel styling, bright white background, and refined sparkle
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion portrait for editorial lookbook or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A professional studio portrait of the adult subject from the required approved-adult face reference against a clean bright white background.
prompt.main_subject: The adult subject from the required approved-adult identity reference, preserving face, ears, nose, mouth, facial proportions, and overall likeness. The subject has blonde hair in a tall heart-shaped boxing bun with two thin straight tresses, looks directly at camera, and wears a caramel strapless top or corset with a matching very short skirt or corset-dress style, cross-ties, brown cloth floral decoration at hip level, diamond necklace, diamond earrings, and a small ring.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated professional model pose with one arm pushing against the floor, torso presented toward camera, bright clean white background, and jewelry and brown floral hip decoration clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright studio lighting with realistic shadows and controlled luster on the hair, skin, jewelry, and fabric, clean polished fashion mood, and crisp white environment.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional studio photography, high-resolution 32K-style sharpness, realistic skin texture and natural tone variation, detailed hair bun, fabric cross-ties, floral cloth, and jewelry, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a professional high-resolution studio portrait using the required approved-adult face reference. Keep the face, ears, nose, mouth, facial proportions, and overall likeness unchanged. Style the adult subject with blonde hair in a tall heart-shaped boxing bun at the middle of the head, two thin straight tresses, a direct gaze, and polished eye makeup. Seat the subject in a professional model pose with one arm pushing against the floor and the torso presented toward camera. Preserve the caramel strapless top or corset, matching very short skirt or corset-dress style, cross-ties on the front and sides, large brown cloth floral decoration at hip level, fancy diamond necklace, tiny diamond earrings, and small ring. Use a clean bright white background, bright studio lighting with realistic shadows and controlled luster, natural skin texture, high-resolution 32K-style detail, subtle film grain, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face alteration, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed cross-ties, broken jewelry, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: approved adult face identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult subject's face, facial proportions, and likeness; do not substitute, beautify, or alter identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult face reference. Keep identity, blonde heart-shaped bun, caramel strapless styling, brown hip floral decoration, seated floor-supported pose, jewelry, and bright white studio. Non-essential lighting details may vary.

changes: Replaced suggestive expression wording with a confident direct editorial gaze while preserving the outfit and pose.
